transcript.text: Hi, this is Cimo, an AI assistant for Harbour Dental Clinic. This call is recorded and transcribed so the team can follow up. How can I help today?
Hi. Do you have parking for patients, and can I book the earliest checkup tomorrow?
Yes, we have free parking for patients behind the building, with disabled spaces by the entrance. One moment, let me check that.
The earliest slot tomorrow is nine in the morning. Are you a new patient or have you visited us before?
Thanks, Anna. Have you visited us before, or would this be your first time as a new patient?
Just so I get the right appointment, is this your first visit with us, or have you been here before?
